factory.title: Iflowa lefektri
factory.lede: Imishini neziseli zakho, ifundwa ngesikhathi sangempela, nesikrini somsebenzisi phezu kwesakhiwo, uhla lomsebenzi, umlando kanye ne-OEE. Ukufunda kuqala: akukho okubhalwa emshinini lapha ngaphandle uma uvula ukubhala kwaleyo divayisi eyodwa uphinde uqinisekise ngakunye ukubhala.
factory.safety: Akuyona uhlelo lokuphepha, futhi akuyona ingxenye yanoma yiluphi uchungechunge lokuphepha. Izivikelo, izikhiyo nezinkinobho zesimo esiphuthumayo zemishini yona kuphela izinsiza zokuphepha.
factory.m.title: Imishini neziseli ({n})
factory.m.fromFlow: Isiteshi ngasinye sesakhiwo sokugeleza kwezinto, {n} sonke, ngumshini lapha.
factory.m.noFlow: Azikho izikhundla okwamanje: vula Ukugeleza kwezinto bese uhlela izikhundla, noma yengeze umshini ngesandla.
factory.m.name: Igama
factory.c.name: Iseli {n}
factory.src.viaPage: Ikhasi lewebhu lingafunda kuphela i-agent ye-https evumela le sayithi. Izi-agent eziningi zesitobhi ziyi-http evamile kwinethiwekhi yakho: zifunde nge-CadCraft Studio.
factory.src.needsStudio: Ukufunda lolu hlobo lwesixhumanisi kudinga i-CadCraft Studio: ikhasi lewebhu alikwazi ukuvula uxhumo lwenethiwekhi yefektri.
factory.src.sim: Imshini elingisiwe ngembewu: isebenzisa izingxenye, iyalinda njalo, iphazamiseka ngokungahleliwe futhi ilungiswe. Imbewu efanayo inikeza umlando ofanayo.
factory.w.title: Ukubhala kule divayisi
factory.w.note: Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Ukubhala kudinga leli switshi lale divayisi eyodwa nokuthi yebo kokubhalwa ngakunye. Le bhilidi alinayo ichibiyela elingabhala emshinini noma ku-PLC, ngakho ukubhala kuyenqatshwa futhi kuyasho lokho.
factory.w.allowAsk: Vumela ukubhala kumshini {name}? Lonke ukubhala kusabuza kuqala. Akuyona uhlelo lokuphepha.
factory.w.r.no-channel: Akubhalwanga: kule bhilidi akukho ndlela yokubhala emshinini noma ku-PLC. Ukufunda kuphela.
factory.mon.title: Okuphilayo
factory.mon.simNote: Yonke imishini iyalingiswa, ngakho iwashi lingasheshiswa.
factory.err.transport: Akukho ndlela yokufinyelela idivayisi kusuka lapha.
factory.err.url: Ikheli le-agent kufanele liqale nge-http:// noma https://.
factory.err.host-host: Lokho akusona igama lomshini noma ikheli.
factory.err.host-public: Akusenetheweki yangasese: qala ugunyaze lo mshini kuqala.
factory.jobs.title: Uhla lomsebenzi ({n} olindile)
factory.jobs.note: Izinhlelo ezithunyelwe kulawulo lomshini. Thumela kubeka ifayela emshinini nge-CadCraft Studio's Thumela kumshini. Akukho lapha okuqala umshini: qala kumshini.
factory.jobs.needsStudio: Ukuthumela kudinga i-CadCraft Studio nomshini osethiwe kumasethingi awo omshini. Usengakwazi ukubeka emugqeni, ukuhlola nokugcina imisebenzi.
factory.jobs.badFile: Lena akulona igama lefayela lohlelo imishini eyamukelayo.
factory.jobs.sendHint: Ivula i-CadCraft Studio's Thumela kumshini. Ifayela liyalayishwa, alisebenzi.
factory.oee.title: Umlando ne-OEE
factory.oee.note: OEE = ukutholakala × ukusebenza × ikhwalithi, kusuka kokufundiwe. Okuma okuhleliwe nesikhathi lapho umshini ungabonakali akufakwa esikhathini esihleliwe.
factory.oee.over: Okulinganisiwe {p}: isikhathi esiphelele sokuzungeza mhlawumbe side kakhulu.
factory.part.title: Iflowa lefektri
factory.part.note: Thumela uhlelo ku-Manufacture (Post… noma Thumela kumshini…), bese uluthumela emugqeni womsebenzi wefektri kwi-ModelCraft noma ugcine njengefayela lomsebenzi.
factory.part.noStore: Lesi sisekeli sewebhu asigcini lutho: gcina ifayela lomsebenzi esikhundleni salokho.
